watches.name: M-1 Krons
watches.description: Created with Krons, Aera’s first retail partner and exclusive retailer in Stockholm, the M-1 Krons marks our first collaboration with a watch retailer. A contemporary interpretation of the classic military field watch, it pairs a Ghost Grey dial with warm beige, three-dimensional Globolight™ numerals formed from Tritec Swiss Super-LumiNova®, a contrasting black small-seconds register and a satin-brushed 904L stainless steel case. Swiss made and hand-wound, it is produced in an edition of 25 individually numbered pieces. Krons has been part of Stockholm’s watchmaking landscape for over half a century, with its home in the city’s PK-huset on Hamngatan since the early 1970s. The store has become a well-established destination for watch collectors and enthusiasts. As Aera’s first retail partner, Krons has played an important role in introducing our watches to customers in Sweden. This collaboration celebrates that relationship and a shared appreciation for thoughtful design, precision engineering and craft. For this special edition, we returned to the M-1, Aera’s contemporary interpretation of the classic military field watch. Inspired by the functional clarity and reliability of the British military watches known as the Dirty Dozen, the M-1 Krons retains the original’s compact 39mm proportions, straightforward functionality and restrained design, introducing a new visual character to a familiar instrument. The Ghost Grey dial is complemented by warm beige, three-dimensional Globolight™ numerals formed from solid blocks of Tritec Swiss Super-LumiNova®, with matching luminous detailing across the hands. A recessed black small-seconds register at six o’clock provides contrast, whilst the outer railroad minute track is in white, maintaining a clean and balanced display. In low-light conditions, the numerals and hands emit a distinctive green glow, whilst the hand-applied, three-dimensional Aera logo, also formed from Globolight™, illuminates white. The 39mm case is crafted from satin-brushed 904L stainless steel, selected for its superior corrosion resistance and deeper lustre compared to conventional 316L steel. More challenging to machine and finish, 904L offers the durability and character expected of an everyday instrument. The signature curved dial profile sits beneath a domed sapphire crystal, whilst the ergonomically angled lugs and integrated strap design ensure a comfortable and balanced fit on the wrist. Inside is a Swiss-made Sellita SW216-1 Elaboré-grade manual-winding movement with a 42-hour power reserve, chosen for its reliability, precision and long-term serviceability. Winding the watch becomes a small ritual, a moment of interaction between the instrument and the person wearing it. Swiss made and hand assembled by skilled artisans, the M-1 Krons also retains the 100m water resistance of the original M-1 Field. Designed to be worn often, relied upon daily and kept for years to come, the M-1 Krons brings together the functional character of the field watch with a collaboration built on a longstanding relationship. Produced in a special edition of 25 individually numbered pieces, each M-1 Krons features an engraved case back bearing the Aera x Krons collaboration mark. The watch comes fitted with a dark brown leather strap with contrasting white stitching and quick-release functionality, complementing the warmth of the dial and numerals. A handmade brown leather pouch, crafted in the UK and featuring Aera x Krons detailing, completes the presentation.

The richly textured exterior is complemented by a smooth leather lining that creates a comfortable interface with the skin, providing exceptional comfort throughout extended wear. This refined composition is anchored by a precision-engineered 904L marine-grade stainless steel buckle, hand-polished to a brilliant finish that complements the most distinguished timepieces. Available in six distinctive colorways: Jet Black with Black Stitching Jet Black with White Stitching Jet Black with Red Stitching International Orange Moon Grey Khaki Each strap incorporates our integrated quick-release system for effortless interchangeability without tools, adapting to your wardrobe and occasion with sophisticated simplicity.

watches.name: P-1 Air Force
watches.description: The P-1 Air Force is Aera’s contemporary expression of the pilot’s watch, shaped by aviation discipline, instrument clarity, and the distinctive grey-blue tone long associated with the Royal Air Force. Built around the same principles as the original P-1 Pilot, it is stripped back, highly legible, and designed for life beyond the cockpit. The matte velvet grey-blue dial gives the watch a calm, precise character, whilst the large three-dimensional numerals, raised Aera logo, and clearly defined outer seconds track keep the display direct and easy to read. In low light, the numerals and Aera logo, formed from 3D Tritec Swiss Super-LumiNova®, emit a vibrant orange glow, a colour rarely seen on contemporary pilot’s watches. White hour and minute hand frames are hand-filled with Grade X1 Swiss Super-LumiNova®, whilst the seconds hand features a luminous tip for added clarity after dark. The 43mm case gives the P-1 Air Force the presence expected of a modern pilot’s watch, balanced by a refined case profile, curved lugs, and an integrated strap system designed to sit securely and comfortably on the wrist. Aera’s signature one-piece dished dial curves upward beneath the domed sapphire crystal, creating the smooth, pebble-like silhouette that defines the P-1 collection. For this edition, the case shape has been subtly refined and the lugs carefully reworked to improve balance when worn with Aera’s integrated straps. Inside is a Swiss-made Sellita SW200-1 Elaboré-grade automatic movement with up to 41 hours of power reserve, selected for its reliability, precision, and long-term serviceability. Each watch is Swiss Made and hand assembled by skilled artisans before final testing and quality control. The case, case back, and buckles are crafted from brushed 904L stainless steel, chosen for its superior corrosion resistance and deeper lustre compared to industry-standard 316L steel. More difficult to machine and finish, 904L gives the watch the durability and character expected of a mechanical instrument built for regular use. A screw-down crown and 100m water resistance add everyday robustness, whilst the updated six-screw case back gives the watch a more utilitarian, industrial character. Precise, legible, and quietly capable, the P-1 Air Force is designed to become a dependable everyday instrument – worn often, relied upon daily and kept for years. Produced in an edition of 300 pieces, each P-1 Air Force comes fitted with a Battleship Grey FKM rubber strap alongside a second integrated strap selected from a curated range. Both feature brushed 904L stainless steel buckles and quick-release spring bars, allowing the watch to adapt easily between environments and occasions.

watches.name: P-1 Moon
watches.description: The P-1 Moon is Aera’s quieter interpretation of the modern pilot’s watch, shaped by instrument clarity, lunar tones, and the curiosity of looking beyond the known. Where the P-1 Air Force is grounded in precision and navigation, the P-1 Moon explores a more atmospheric side of the collection. Its smooth lunar-grey dial takes its cues from the subtle tones of the moon’s surface, whilst the discreet aqua marker at 12 o’clock introduces a controlled point of contrast. Large three-dimensional numerals, the raised Aera logo, and a clearly defined outer seconds track give the dial structure and immediate legibility. In darkness, the 3D Tritec Swiss Super-LumiNova® emits a vivid aqua-blue glow inspired by the celestial tones that influenced the watch, whilst the white hour and minute hand frames are hand-filled with Grade X1 Swiss Super-LumiNova® for added visibility after dark. The 43mm case gives the P-1 Moon the presence of a modern pilot’s watch, balanced by a refined profile designed for comfort and wearability throughout the day. Beneath the domed sapphire crystal, Aera’s signature one-piece dished dial curves upward at the edges, giving the watch its smooth, sculptural silhouette. The case shape has been subtly refined and the lugs carefully reworked to help the P-1 Moon sit naturally on the wrist when paired with Aera’s integrated straps. Inside is a Swiss-made Sellita SW200-1 Elaboré-grade automatic movement with up to 41 hours of power reserve, selected for its reliability, precision and long-term serviceability. Each watch is Swiss Made and hand assembled by skilled artisans before final testing and quality control. The case, case back, and buckles are crafted from brushed 904L stainless steel, chosen for its superior corrosion resistance and deeper lustre compared to industry-standard 316L steel. Across the P-1 Moon, the brushed steel gives the watch a quiet depth that complements the lunar-grey dial without making the design feel decorative. A screw-down crown and 100m water resistance provide the robustness expected of a modern tool watch, whilst the updated six-screw case back adds a more utilitarian, industrial character. Calm, legible, and quietly expressive, the P-1 Moon is designed not only for where you are, but for where you might go next. Produced in an edition of 300 pieces, each P-1 Moon comes fitted with a Blue Lagoon FKM rubber strap alongside a second integrated strap selected from a curated range. Both feature brushed 904L stainless steel buckles and quick-release spring bars, allowing the watch to take on a different character with ease.

watches.name: D-1 Ocean
watches.description: At 44mm, the D-1 Ocean has the presence of a professional diving instrument, balanced by a refined case profile designed for comfort and wearability throughout the day. Its signature one-piece dished dial curves upward beneath the domed sapphire crystal, creating the smooth, pebble-like silhouette that defines the D-1 collection. The angled lugs and integrated strap system have been carefully refined to help the watch hug the wrist naturally, improving balance and long-term comfort. Inside is an upgraded Swiss-made Sellita SW200-1 Elaboré automatic movement with a 38–41 hour power reserve, selected for its reliability, precision and long-term serviceability. Each watch is Swiss made and hand assembled by skilled artisans before final testing and quality control. The case, bezel, buckle and case back are machined from brushed 904L stainless steel — chosen for its superior corrosion resistance and deeper lustre compared to industry-standard steels. More difficult to machine and finish, 904L requires additional time and precision, but the result is a case designed to wear beautifully over many years of use. The satin-finished ceramic bezel rotates with a precise 120-click action, while the screw-down crown and updated six-screw case back help ensure 300m water resistance and add a more utilitarian feel. Designed as a true modern tool watch, the D-1 Ocean feels equally at home underwater or on dry land — built for regular use and designed to wear beautifully over time. Over time, it is designed to become familiar in the best possible way — a watch reached for instinctively, worn often and relied upon daily. Produced in an edition of 300 pieces, each D-1 Ocean comes fitted with an Arctic White FKM rubber strap alongside a second integrated strap selected from a curated range. Both feature brushed 904L steel hardware and quick-release spring bars, allowing the watch to adapt easily to different environments and occasions.

The angled lugs and integrated strap system have been carefully refined to help the watch sit naturally on the wrist, creating a secure and balanced fit during everyday wear. Powering the watch is an upgraded Swiss-made Sellita SW200-1 Elaboré automatic movement with a 38–41 hour power reserve, chosen for its accuracy, reliability and long-term serviceability. Each watch is Swiss made and hand assembled by skilled artisans before final testing and quality control. The case, bezel, buckle and case back are crafted from brushed 904L stainless steel - a material selected for its exceptional corrosion resistance and durability in demanding environments. While significantly more difficult to machine and finish than industry-standard steels, its durability and distinctive lustre made it the natural choice for the D-1. The unidirectional ceramic bezel rotates with a precise 120-click action, while the screw-down crown and updated six-screw case back contribute to 300m water resistance and add a more utilitarian feel. The result is a diving watch designed not only for performance, but for long-term ownership — robust enough for regular use, yet refined enough to wear effortlessly every day. Built for regular use and long-term ownership, the D-1 Forest is designed to feel as relevant years from now as it does on the first day it is worn. Produced in an edition of 300 pieces, each D-1 Forest comes fitted with an Arctic White FKM rubber strap alongside a second integrated strap selected from a curated range. Both feature brushed 904L steel hardware and quick-release spring bars, allowing the watch to take on a different character with ease.

watches.name: D-1 Diver Blackout
watches.description: A diving watch for the everyday, the AERA x Todd Snyder D-1 Diver Blackout is a contemporary evolution of the classic mid-century tool watch, a masterclass in functional minimalism. Inspired by the robust tool watches worn by 20th-century salvage divers and combat frogmen, this collaborative edition retains professional-grade specifications while being reimagined for contemporary life. The distinctive colour palette was inspired by an off-road expedition through Icelandic landscapes with 'Blackout' capturing the depth of obsidian volcanic sands. With 300m water resistance and a ceramic unidirectional bezel, the D-1 Blackout is the quintessential 21st century diving watch, designed to last a lifetime. What do a British watch brand and an award-winning American men’s fashion brand have in common? More than you might think. Todd Snyder represents the best of contemporary American men’s fashion. His style blends modern sportswear with classic iconic pieces in a way that is both familiar and forward thinking, luxurious and simple. You could say the same thing about Aera’s D-1 Diver watches, meticulously engineered timepieces in which performance and purity of design combine to offer lasting value and functionality for the everyday wearer. When Snyder selects his fabrics, it is with two things in mind: elegance and wearability. While Todd’s materials are wool, cashmere, leather and denim, Aera’s D-1 Blackout is made from Grade 2 Titanium which is over 30% lighter than steel and hypoallergenic on the skin. And it’s easy to wear and gorgeous to look at too. Limited to only 25 units, the D-1 Diver’ Titanium case, bezel and case back are coated with matt black Diamond-Like Carbon (DLC) giving it robustness and lightness while adding scratch resistance. This edition retains the signature one-piece dial, domed glass and Swiss automatic movement of the original D-1. Always striving for improvement, however, we refined the case shape for comfort on the wrist and added 3D Aera logo and hour markers in Swiss Super-LumiNova. Orange accents pop against the dark tonal watch face, and in low-light conditions, the Super-LumiNova® on the markers, numbers and hands glow green for visibility. Legibility, both day and night, are a must for this quintessential tool watch. The versatile D-1 Blackout is more than capable as a tool for deep dives, but it’s just as at home on dry land. The Aera Todd Snyder D-1 Diver is made in Switzerland and is powered by an Elabore grade Sellita automatic movement, chosen for its performance and reliability in all conditions. Like the original D-1 Diver, launched in 2022, this very special edition features the same one-piece dished dial, which curves up around the edges to meet the seamless curve of our domed sapphire crystal glass and ceramic insert bezel. These striking design features are central to the ethos of Aera, giving the case a satisfyingly curved, pebble-like silhouette. We spent valuable time perfecting the angle of the lugs and the integrated straps too to ensure the D-1 hugs the wrist and offers day-long comfort. The uni-directional bezel, meanwhile, rotates with a pleasing ‘click’. And, if you’re counting, a full rotation takes precisely 120 clicks, one for every half-minute. These, for Aera, are hallmarks that define the 21st century tool watch; they also nod with reverence to the 1950’s and 1960’s, the golden era of dive watches. Available in an edition of 25, every purchase features our Scuba Black rubber strap. These come with our quick release mechanism, so you can change the look of the D-1 on the fly, wherever the mood takes you. Every Aera watch is backed by a 3-year warranty and is housed in a protective custom Italian leather pouch, handmade in the UK.

watches.name: P-1 Pilot
watches.description: Built for adventures big and small, the P-1 is the pilot’s watch at its most minimal. We’ve dialled everything back to its purest form, while retaining the characteristically large numerals, large crown and outer seconds track that define the pilot’s watch. We retain our signature one-piece dished dial, which curves up around the edges, meeting the underside of our domed sapphire crystal. It gives the case a satisfyingly curved, pebble-like silhouette. We spent more time perfecting the angle of the lugs, too. This ensures the P-1 hugs the wrist, combining with our integrated straps to provide day-long comfort. Designed to be enjoyed for a lifetime, we’ve engineered the P-1 from the best materials we could find. There’s corrosion-resistant 904L stainless steel for the case and buckle, which have been circularly brushed to give a sleek, rugged feel. A Swiss-made, Elaboré-grade Sellita automatic movement provides the power, with a 38–41 hour power reserve, chosen for its reliability in all conditions. It has always been important for pilot watches to be easy to read. This is the case with the P-1’s large numerals and outer seconds track, which are visible from any angle. This remains true at night, where the numerals, hands and markers light up with a white glow thanks to 3D Swiss Super-LumiNova®. For further functional appeal, the P-1 comes with a screw-down crown and 100 m water resistance. Turn the watch over to reveal the newly designed case back, fixed with six visible screws, adding a utilitarian look and feel. Available in an edition of 300, included with every purchase are two of our integrated straps, which come with matching brushed 904L steel hardware. The P-1 Pilot comes on a pebble-grain Italian leather strap with white stitching, as well as an additional strap, which can be chosen from a pre-selected range. They form perfectly around the wrist thanks to our ergonomically designed lugs, and feature quick-release spring bars, making it easy to switch up the look depending on your outfit or mood.

watches.name: D-1 Diver
watches.description: The D-1 is your daily driver, and like the perfect pair of jeans, is comfortable just about anywhere. Like all our watches, it’s made in Switzerland and is powered by an automatic Elabore grade Sellita movement with a 38-41 hour power reserve, chosen for its reliability in all conditions. A tool watch through and through, its case is made from durable 904L stainless steel, which is known for its anti-corrosion qualities. It is a far more durable alloy than the regular 316L steel more commonly used in the industry, and while it’s more difficult to mill, the extra effort was worth it. In short, it can take a beating and will look even better with a little wear and tear. Life has a habit of throwing the occasional curveball. The D-1 can take it. We retain our signature one-piece dished dial, which curves up around the edges, meeting the bottom of our domed sapphire crystal glass. It gives the case a satisfyingly curved, pebble-like silhouette. We spent more time perfecting the angle of the lugs, too. This ensures the D-1 hugs the wrist, combining with our integrated straps to ensure day-long comfort. The circular brushed case finish perfectly complements the unidirectional satin-finished ceramic bezel, which rotates with a satisfying ‘click’. If you’re counting, a full rotation takes precisely 120 clicks. Diving watches have long been appreciated for their functionality and rugged appeal. The D-1 is no different. It’s more than capable of being used as a tool for regular deep dives, but it’s just as at home under a shirt cuff on dry land. It comes with a screw down crown and a 300m water resistance, which is further improved thanks to the new case back, secured with six visible screws for a utilitarian look. Available in an edition of 300, Included with every purchase are two of our integrated straps which come with matching brushed 904L steel hardware. The D-1 Diver comes on a Scuba Black FKM Rubber as well as an additional strap, which can be chosen from a pre-selected range. They form perfectly around the wrist thanks to our ergonomically designed lugs, and feature our quick-release spring bars, so you can change the look of the D-1 on the fly, wherever your mood takes you.

watches.name: C-1 Chrono
watches.description: Inspired by the golden age of motoring, built for today. The C-1 Chrono is a reverse panda dial chronograph that references the mid-century with its twin register layout. But with its more minimal design it reinterprets the classic racing chronograph with a contemporary look and feel. A mechanical tool, it’s engineered for a life on the road. Like the C-1 Shadow and C-1 Cloud, the C-1 Chrono has been built to Aera’s exacting standards. Its 42mm case is made from 904L stainless steel, a more durable alternative to 316L surgical steel used by most of the watch industry. Our steel is incredibly resistant to corrosion and pitting, and develops a deep lustre not possible with inferior alloys. It’s harder to work with, but for us the extra effort is worth it. The dial is a first for Aera. Our signature dished, one-piece dial has been re-worked with a classic reverse panda design, with white sub-dials on a black background. With racing red hands, which have been hand-painted with lacquer, it calls to mind mid-century chronographs closely associated with motorsport. These tools were once used to record lap times and measure top speeds, during an era when humankind was pushing the limits of performance both on road and track. Inspired by this golden era of motoring, the C-1 Chrono is a mechanical heirloom, referencing iconic mid-century design yet engineered to be used every day. Powering the watch is a bi-compax, Elabore grade Sellita automatic movement, a workhorse that’s renowned for its reliability. It comes with a power reserve of 56 hours, and can be manually wound by unscrewing the crown and pulling it out one stop. It’s housed within a flush-fitting, screw-in case back, engraved with key specifications and the watch’s unique serial number. An edition of only 300 pieces and released in phases, you will find a matching serial number on the reverse side of one of the lugs. Like every Aera design, the C-1 Chrono is all about the details. Underneath the domed sapphire crystal, Tritec Swiss Super-Luminova (™) has been applied by hand to the hour and minute hands, as well as the tips of the sweeping seconds hand and sub-dial hands. In low light these glow bright green, ensuring it’s still easy to operate. The Aera logo meanwhile has been machined from solid Globolight, glowing bright white. Elsewhere, the numbers on the bezel have been hand-filled with lacquer. This all combines to make each piece unique. A mechanical watch is a highly individual purchase, so it’s rewarding to know each one is different. Included with every purchase are two of our integrated straps which come with matching brushed 904L steel hardware The watch comes on a Pebble grain Italian leather with black stitching and in-box you will find a Battleship grey Rubber strap.They form perfectly around the wrist thanks to our ergonomically designed lugs, and feature our quick-release spring bars, making it easy to switch up the look depending on your outfit or mood.

watches.name: M-1 Dune
watches.description: A tool for the everyday. The M-1 Dune is a contemporary, military-inspired watch with a difference. Its party trick is its dial, finished in a dusty pink shade we’ve borrowed from a 1960s desert camouflage scheme, once used by the Special Air Service. For covert operations, the SAS would paint their Land Rovers a fetching pink, which was said to make them invisible in the dunes at dusk and dawn. We’ve taken inspiration from this for the dusty shade used on the M-1 Dune. It changes subtly depending on the sky and the light. In bright sunlight it takes on an almost sandy tone, while in warmer light at dusk and dawn, the pink tones pop. We like to think it’s exactly as the SAS would have intended, acting as an adaptable camouflage for desert dwellers. The rest of the watch is business as usual. 39mm in diameter, it’s powered by a manual-wound Sellita elabore grade movement, known for its reliability in all manner of conditions. Once fully wound, it’ll keep ticking for 42 hours. Assembled and finished by hand in Switzerland, its case is made from 904L stainless steel. A superior steel than the more commonly used 316L alloy, it’s known for its ability to withstand corrosion and pitting. While more difficult to work with, it’s this added durability that ensures our watches are tools for life. Field watches have always been regarded for their rugged functionality. The M-1 Dune is no different. It comes with our dished, one-piece dial as well as our domed sapphire crystal. Combined, this provides clear legibility at all angles and times of day. When the sun does set, it’s still easy to read thanks to the Super-LumiNova®, which we’ve hand-applied to the hands and crown pip. For the large numerals and Aera logo, we’ve hand-applied them from solid blocks of Globolight. This hand-finishing ensures each watch is unique, and lights the M-1 Dune up in bright military green, with the logo shining bright white. Like every Aera watch, the M-1 Dune comes with its own serial number on the screw down crown. In an edition of just 300 watches, it gives each watch an individual flair. We also include two of our integrated straps in Charcoal Grey suede and an additional one of your own choosing. Both have matching 904L stainless steel hardware and feature our quick-release mechanism, so you can swap them out on the fly. We spent three years perfecting their integrated design, which forms around the wearer’s wrist for day-long comfort. Also included with the watch is our signature black pebble grain Italian leather pouch, handmade in the UK, which is made to keep the watch safe on your travels.

watches.name: Suede - Charcoal Grey - 20MM
watches.description: Meticulously crafted from premium Italian suede, our suede collection celebrates the perfect balance between refined luxury and tactile pleasure. Each strap is carefully selected for its exceptional nap, velvety texture, and rich depth of colour that creates a subtle yet distinctive presence on the wrist. The sumptuous suede exterior features precision stitching that reinforces its architectural lines while ensuring lasting durability. A leather lining creates a comfortable interface with the skin, providing a gentle embrace throughout the day. This sophisticated composition is completed by a precision-engineered 904L marine-grade stainless steel buckle, hand-polished to a luminous finish that harmonizes beautifully with Aera timepieces. Available in two captivating colourways; Rose Quartz and Charcoal Grey, each strap incorporates our integrated quick-release system for effortless interchangeability without tools, adapting to your mood and occasion with refined simplicity.

watches.name: C-1 Rennsport
watches.description: An homage to the quintessential sports car, this limited edition C-1 has been created in partnership with Porsche 911 restomod specialist, Rennsport in an edition of 25 units. Inspired by the golden age of analogue motoring, it combines our modern design aesthetic with 3-D-printed sub-dials in the style of Porsche’s famous Fuchs wheels, a signature feature of the classic 911. Renowned for its light weight and nimble handling, the Porsche 911 redefined what was possible when it launched in 1964. Today, Rennsport restores early models with uprated engines, suspension and bespoke interiors, while tweaking the exterior designs, for a cleaner, more contemporary look. We saw a parallel with how we work, and the C-1 was the perfect starting point. A contemporary update on the classic mid-century chronograph, its minimal design combines clean lines with precision engineering, just like a Rennsport 911. Designed to last multiple lifetimes, it’s made from durable 904L stainless steel, an alloy far more durable and corrosion-resistant than the industry-standard 316L. Our steel is harder to mill, but we believe it’s worth going the extra mile, and the results speak for themselves. Elsewhere, the watch features our signature one-piece dished dial, which curves around its edges, seamlessly meeting the bottom of the domed sapphire crystal. This combination gives the display a unique sense of depth. Powering the C-1 Rennsport is an automatic Sellita bi-compax elabore movement, ensuring accuracy and reliability, whether you happen to be behind the wheel of a classic 911 or not. Elsewhere, bright green Super-LumiNova® lights up the hands and crown pip, while the Aera logo is machined from solid Globolight™ for an icey white glow. The lacquer on the bezel, crown dot and hands are all applied by hand, making each watch different from the last. Each C-1 Rennsport Chronograph comes on a black pebble leather strap with red stitching. Our straps are integrated, offering a seamless look, and feature our quick release spring bars so they can be swapped with ease. We spent three years perfecting their shape and the angle of the lugs for unrivalled comfort. For Rennsport car owners, there is an exclusive option to engrave their car’s serial number on the case lug. At an additional cost, there is also an option to order a bespoke strap made from the materials used in the interior of their own car.

watches.name: M-1 Blackbird
watches.description: A field watch for today. The M-1 Blackbird takes the archetypal field watch of the 20th century and reinvents it with a minimal brushed PVD case, hand-applied Globolight™ numerals and our signature domed, one-piece dial. A contemporary update on the classic military design, it has an understated, stealthy look. Like its namesake, it flies under the radar. Field watches have long been relied on by those on the ground, in the sea or in the air. They are durable tools, built to withstand whatever the day throws at you. This is what the M-1 Blackbird is all about. It’s a contemporary, functional bit of kit, built to last and designed to accompany you on adventures big and small. It’s an analogue tool, engineered from the best materials we could find. There’s the 39mm case, our smallest ever, which is made from our 904L stainless steel. Much harder to machine than regular 316L steel, it’s more durable and resistant to corrosion, making it the obvious choice for a tool watch, despite the extra work. We’ve then given it a black PVD coating as well as a brushed finish, for that sleek, tactical look. This makes the M-1 Blackbird particularly easy to wear, whether as part of a monochrome look or as the muted finishing touch to tailoring. Like the heritage military-issued pieces it’s inspired by, it’s powered by a manual winding movement. The elabore grade Sellita calibre has a 42 hour power reserve and is known for its reliability in all conditions. It’s housed underneath our signature one-piece, dished dial, which helps give the M-1 its contemporary feel. The small seconds sub-dial combines with the outer railroad track for that classic field watch design, while the large numerals and subtle, blue lacquered detailing help elevate the military-inspired look. This is furthered by the hand-applied Super-LumiNova® on hands, markers and crown pip, as well as the track on the sub-dial. The numerals and Aera logo meanwhile are hand-applied and cut from solid blocks of Globolight. When the lights go out the watch glows bright blue in the dark, with the logo shining bright white. The M-1 Blackbird comes on an integrated smooth black Italian leather strap with black stitching and a 904L stainless steel buckle. In addition, you will receive a complimentary integrated grey suede strap with a 904L stainless steel buckle. Both straps feature a quick release mechanism for easy switching customisation. A handmade black pebble grain Italian leather pouch also accompanies every watch.

watches.name: M-1 Field
watches.description: A field watch for today. The M-1 takes the archetypal field watch of the 20th century and reinvents it with a minimal 904L stainless steel case, hand-applied Globolight™ numerals and our signature dished, one-piece dial. Stripped back to the bare essentials, it combines design purity with Swiss engineering. Built to loyally accompany you on adventures near and far. Field watches have long been relied on by those on the ground, in the sea or in the air. They are durable tools, built to withstand whatever the day throws at you. The M-1 Field is no different, encompassing everything we’ve learned in a small 39mm package. This is the watch you can take on your travels, whether you’re circumnavigating the world or heading to a business meeting. It is designed to be worn with anything, anywhere and never look out of place. Powering the M-1 is a manual-wound Sellita movement, known for its reliability in all manner of conditions. Once fully wound, it’ll keep ticking for 42 hours. It’s housed within our satin-brushed case, which looks the part and thanks to its 904L steel, is built to withstand corrosion. Our steel contains higher chromium and nickel content than the industry standard 316L steel, making it far more durable and able to withstand exposure to extreme environments. The domed sapphire crystal meanwhile combines with our signature dished, one-piece dial to create a 3-D look, elevating and updating the military-inspired design. Elsewhere, a classic railroad minute track runs around the dial’s edge, and large numerals, hands and sub-seconds offer impressive readability in all lights. This is helped by the Super-LumiNova®, which is hand-applied to the hands, markers and crown pip, as well as the track on the sub-dial, making each watch unique. The numerals and Aera logo meanwhile are hand-applied and cut from solid blocks of Globolight. This ensures the watch glows a bright military green in the dark, with the logo emitting a bright white light. The M1-Field watch comes on an integrated smooth Jet Black Italian leather strap with white stitching and a 904L stainless steel buckle. In addition, you will receive a complimentary Charcoal Grey suede strap. Both straps feature a quick release mechanism for easy switching, as well as our integrated design which forms comfortably around the wrist. We spent three years perfecting the shape of our straps and lugs, purely so they would be comfortable all day long. A handmade black pebble grain Italian leather pouch also accompanies every watch.

watches.name: C-1 Shadow
watches.description: A chronograph for the 21st century, the C-1 Shadow is a mechanical heirloom designed for daily wear. It’s a contemporary update on the classic chronograph, with an all black design and PVD case, giving it a stealthy, understated look and feel. Inspired by the mid-century but updated with a minimal display and durable 904L stainless steel, it’s built to last multiple lifetimes. Entirely assembled and finished by hand in Switzerland, the C-1 uses an automatic Sellita bi-compax movement, renowned for its reliability in all conditions. The antithesis to the digital age, it’s a handbuilt mechanical object intended to celebrate classic analogue design. But the watch’s modern, minimal design is entirely original. It features our signature one-piece, dished dial, which comes for the first time with two sub-registers at 3 and 9 O’clock. Stripped back so that only the essential details are present, it combines with our domed sapphire crystal, further exaggerating the case’s curves. Like all our watches, we’ve made the case from 904L stainless steel. Far superior to the more commonly used 316L alloy, our steel has greater corrosion resistance, and while it’s more difficult to machine, it’s this added durability that made it perfect for our tool watches. With the C-1 Shadow, we’ve given it a PVD coating and a brushed finish, for a deep matt look that gives the watch its stealthy feel. It’s the hand-finishing that makes the C-1 really special. The central seconds chronograph hand, matching register pointers, and crown pip have all been painted by hand in a vivid red lacquer. While the hours and minutes hands, as well as the white tips of the sub-dial hands have also been hand filled, this time with Super-LumiNova®, which glows bright green. Elsewhere, our Aera logo has been cut from solid Globolight™, glowing white like the midday sun. Like all Aera watches, each C-1 Shadow comes with its own serial number engraved on the screw down caseback. This makes each one unique, and in an edition of just 300 pieces. We also include two of our integrated straps in Black FKM Scuba Rubber and Orange Italian Pebble Grain Leather with black PVD 906L steel hardware. They form perfectly around the wrist thanks to our ergonomically designed lugs, and feature our quick-release spring bars, making it easy to switch up the look depending on your outfit or mood.

watches.name: C-1 Cloud
watches.description: A chronograph for the 21st century, the C-1 Cloud is a mechanical heirloom designed for daily wear. It offers a contemporary take on the classic chronograph, with a tonal white design that combines different shades and textures. Perfect for travels far and wide, or adventures nearer to home, it’s a tool you can rely on day in, day out. Assembled and finished by hand in Switzerland, the C-1 is powered by an automatic Sellita bi-compax movement. An entirely analogue experience like a vintage film camera or a classic car, this gives it a tactile, ‘living’ quality lost on new technology. But it’s no nostalgia trip, either. We’ve designed it with a contemporary, minimal look, referencing the past without being defined by it. There’s our signature one-piece dished dial, which combines with the domed sapphire crystal for a unique sense of depth. The dark grey printed markings add subtle contrast, while the case is built to last from brushed 904L stainless steel. This is a much harder metal to work with, but it offers vastly improved durability and corrosion resistance when compared to the 316L steel used by the majority of watchmakers. It’s worth the extra work. The C-1 Cloud thrives in the sun but looks just as good in the shade. The seconds hands have been dipped in sky blue lacquer for a subtle pop. The tips meanwhile have been coated in bright green Super-LumiNova®, along with the hours and minute hands and crown pip, so it can be clearly read and operated at night. This has all been done by hand, making each watch completely unique. Elsewhere, our Aera logo has been cut from solid Globolight™, glowing white like the midday sun. Like all Aera watches, each C-1 Cloud comes with its own serial number engraved on the screw down caseback. This makes each one unique, and in an edition of just 300 pieces. We also include two of our integrated straps in Arctic White rubber and Italian Cloud Grey leather. They form perfectly around the wrist thanks to our ergonomically designed lugs, and feature our quick-release spring bars, making it easy to switch up the look depending on your outfit or mood.

watches.name: Leather Watch Pouch
watches.description: The AERA leather pouch is constructed from Italian soft-grain calf leather and has been made completely by hand in the UK. The supple, shaped construction provides a safe place to store your watch when you’re on the move. It fastens with a simple gunmetal stud over a single slit, keeping the design minimal and the case secure. The Storm Grey, Desert Sand, Forest Green and Ocean Blue colour-ways have been made in a limited edition run of 30 pieces. Each pouch comes with a one year warranty.
